parts.name: pulmonary valve
parts.hint: The flap guarding the way out to the lungs.

parts.name: aortic valve
parts.hint: The flap guarding the way out to the body.

parts.name: mitral valve
parts.hint: The valve between the left atrium and left ventricle.

parts.name: tricuspid valve
parts.hint: The valve between the right atrium and right ventricle.

parts.name: pulmonary veins
parts.hint: The vessels bringing oxygen-rich blood from the lungs back to the heart.

parts.name: aorta
parts.hint: The great vessel carrying blood out to the whole body.

parts.name: pulmonary artery
parts.hint: The vessel taking blood from the heart to the lungs for oxygen.

parts.name: superior vena cava
parts.hint: The big vein bringing blood down from the head and arms.

parts.name: inferior vena cava
parts.hint: The big vein bringing blood up from the lower body.

parts.name: right atrium
parts.hint: The upper chamber that receives tired blood returning from the body.

parts.name: left atrium
parts.hint: The upper chamber that receives fresh blood back from the lungs.

parts.name: left ventricle
parts.hint: The strongest chamber; it pumps blood out to the whole body.

parts.name: right ventricle
parts.hint: The lower chamber that pumps blood to the lungs.
